title: Karnataka High Court quashes case against MLA Munirathna booked for forcing people to wear BJP's shawl
description: The Karnataka High Court has quashed a First Information Report (FIR) against BJP Member of Legislative Assembly (MLA) Munirathna for having forced people to wear BJP's shawl during elections [Munirathna v State by Nandini Layout]In a brief 6-page order dated July 3, Justice M Nagaprasanna said that the complaint against Munirathna for an offence under Section 171C (interfering with voting right) of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) was not lodged by an officer of the court or a public servant and thi
